headline: Latam Airlines Revises 2026 Outlook Despite $441 Million Q3 Profit
summary: Latam Airlines lowered its 2026 operating profit projection as fuel costs reached 40% of total expenses, despite posting a $441 million profit in the third quarter.
why: Airline profit projections and operating margins reflect jet fuel price volatility and regional passenger demand dynamics in Latin American aviation.

impacts.name: LATAM Airlines Group SA
impacts.why: Operating profit projection was reduced due to fuel costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Lowering the 2026 operating profit projection due to high fuel expenses outweighed third-quarter profit figures.
